_help: Order of the modules = order in this list. enabled=false skips a module (Sign up is off). The title is what -g "1 · Login module" matches. Keys must match the step lists in modules/flow/journey.spec.ts.

modules.title: 1 · Login module (page checks → Authenticate → signed-in checks)
2 · Assistant home module (headline, analysis cards, header, Change repository dialog - nothing is started)
3 · Repo module (home → import repository → choose repository → branch → Confirm)
4 · Coverage module (Coverage preview → Review branches → Continue)
5 · Plan module (Run plan - Execute run is never clicked)
6 · Context module (Repository ready bar, Source details, Repository history)
7 · Execution module (Execute run → Open Confidence Engine → wait for the run → results)
8 · Confidence Engine module (every part of the Confidence Engine page after the run)
9 · Confidence Graph module (every part of the Confidence Graph page)
10 · Confidence Object module (every part of the Confidence Object page)
11 · Latest commit module (dummy README commit → Analyze latest commit → wait for the new run)
13 · Account module (Account page and Billing page - nothing is bought or changed)
14 · Support module (Support menu, Live Chat, ticket dialog, User Guide - nothing is sent)
15 · Redirects module (404 pages, old addresses, SCM integrations, left menu, run id protection)
16 · Sign out module (sign out → sign in with Enter)
17 · Sign up module (the Register page - NO account is ever created)
